name: Problem Cell Subdivision for Curvilinear Grids
definition: A strategy to handle non-planar quadrilateral faces in curvilinear grids that cause self-intersection or multiple intersections with a single viewing ray, by temporarily subdividing only the affected 'problem cells' into tetrahedra while leaving other cells as quadrilaterals.
summary: Problem Cell Subdivision is a viewpoint-dependent strategy that temporarily subdivides only distorted hexahedral cells into tetrahedra to fix visibility sorting, avoiding the high computational cost of full tetrahedral subdivision.
